title: The Daily Five
dek: Five questions from this week's Israeli sports headlines, spanning Olympic history, basketball, football and Israelis abroad.

questions.question: Who did Ariel "Arik" Ze'evi defeat by ippon to win Israel's first medal of the Athens 2004 Olympics?
questions.explanation: Ze'evi beat Dutch judoka Elco van der Geest by ippon in the men's 100kg bronze-medal contest at Ano Liossia Olympic Hall on 19 August 2004.

questions.question: Which NBA team originally drafted new Hapoel Jerusalem signing David Roddy 23rd overall in 2022, before trading him on draft night?
questions.explanation: Roddy was picked 23rd overall by Philadelphia in the 2022 NBA draft and traded to Memphis that same night.

questions.question: Who scored the only goal as Maccabi Tel Aviv beat Maccabi Netanya 1-0 to reach the Toto Cup final?
questions.explanation: Helio Varela scored in the 17th minute to send Maccabi Tel Aviv into a Toto Cup final derby against Hapoel Tel Aviv.

questions.question: Playing abroad, which Turkish Süper Lig club did Dia Saba score twice for in a 3-0 win over Erzurumspor?
questions.explanation: Saba scored twice (53', 62') for Amedspor, who are playing their first-ever season in Turkey's top flight.

questions.question: What time did Gashau Ayale run to take individual marathon bronze at the 2026 European Athletics Championships in Birmingham?
questions.explanation: Ayale finished in 2:09:21 for individual bronze, and combined with teammates Tadesse Getahon and Haimro Alame for team gold.
